name: blueprint/company-watch
description: Watch named companies for material news: keyless sources feed a rolling window, rh_text_extract pulls mention + claim triples, rh_text_summarise composes the digest, notify fires only on material change.
use_cases: what changed about X this week
ingredients: rh_text_extract mention triples { company, claim, date }
recipe: fetch the sources -> extract { company, claim, date } triples -> append watch:<company>:<ts> -> diff the window against the previous digest -> material = new claim or tone shift -> summarise + notify once + store the digest
result_kind: rolling window records + one digest per material change
cost_hint: one model call per source batch; sources keyless
pitfalls: material means a NEW claim - repetition is not news
the same source can 403 - the blocked-page-recovery ladder applies
keep the window capped; the rolling scan is the trend
